title: Winvoy
tagline: Winvoy is a decentralised invoice finance platform for small and medium businesses
description: Winvoy allows companies to extend flexible payment terms to their B2B clients, by giving easy access to credit collateralized by their outstanding invoices. The idea is to build a protocol to manage different liquidity pools (a mix between different protocols and our own) where investors will be able to generate returns based on financing companies and their trade receivables.
how_its_made:
The project is built with React and MaterialUI on the frontend, and Solidity for the smart contracts. It communicates with Aave's contracts for the borrow and repay functions. We didn't get to create our own liquidity pools, but it's coming next.



We are also looking at different oracles in order to connect them to credit scoring companies and other data sources, to model the risk for each facility.
